name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Lemon Cherry Gelato
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Lemon Cherry Gelato gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Lemon Cherry Gelato is a hugely popular hybrid known for its rich, layered flavor. Expect sweet cherry and bright citrus up front, rounded out by creamy, dessert-like gelato smoothness and a subtly gassy finish. The effect is balanced and easygoing — a relaxed, feel-good calm paired with a gentle mood lift, making it a versatile pick that fits just about any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Lemon Cherry Gelato flavor — sweet cherry and citrus with creamy gelato smoothness
Balanced hybrid effects — relaxed, uplifting, and versatile any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Lemon Cherry Gelato is ready whenever you are.
